newsitem.title: UK: Antonov AN-124 freighter gets anti-noise approval.
newsitem.headline: Antonov AN-124 freighter gets anti-noise approval.

text.p: An Antonov AN-124 freighter has gained strict International Civil Aviaton Organisation (ICAO) 'Chapter 3' noise level certification, said its manufacturer.

Ukraine-based Antonov Design Bureau, together with its worldwide UK general sales agent, UK company Air Foyle, said in a statement that after 15 months of testing and modification, the 150-tonne capacity aircraft received ICAO certification on April 25.
"In early May, it operated its first 'Stage 3' flight from Houston to Karachi, carrying 55 tonnes of drilling-related components," said Air Foyle commercial manager Paul Furlonger.

"We fly five AN-124s. The first to be hushkitted will be followed soon by a second, currently undergoing refurbishment by Antonov, and we expect the whole fleet to be 'Chapter 3' certified by the turn of the century," he said.

Furlonger added that while the United States and Europe have set a timetable to ban noisy non-Chapter 3 aircraft from 2000 and 2002 respectively, many airports had already introduced their own unilateral restrictions on these aircraft types.

"For example, we already can't fly a non-Stage 3 AN-124 into Amsterdam Schiphol and the official EU ban is still some time away," he noted. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
